config_dir.description: Directory containing user ~/.bogofilter.cf and other config files. Overrides BOGOFILTER_DIR and home directory. See ENVIRONMENT.

wordlist_dir.description: Directory for the Berkeley DB wordlist.db and related files. See -d option in man page.

cache_size.description: Berkeley DB cache size in MiB. Recommended: one third of database file size. See -k option.

spam_header_name.description: Name of the header field inserted when -p (passthrough) mode is used.

robx.description: Score (spam probability) assigned to unseen tokens. Default 0.5 per documentation.

robs.description: Weight applied to robx for rare tokens. See -m option.

min_dev.description: Minimum deviation from 0.5 for tokens to be used in classification. See -m option.

spam_cutoff.description: Threshold above which messages are marked as spam. See -o option.

ham_cutoff.description: Threshold below which messages are marked as ham; if 0 or equal to spam-cutoff, tristate mode is disabled. See -o option.

sp_esf.description: Spam effective size factor (ESF). See -E option.

ns_esf.description: Non-spam (ham) effective size factor (ESF). See -E option.

log_enabled.description: If true, enables logging via syslog (implies -l option).

log_tag.description: Tag for syslog entries when logging is enabled. Requires log_enabled.

timestamp_date.description: Override current date for token timestamps. 0 disables timestamping. See -y option.

debug_flags.description: Debug flags for output. See -x option and debug.h for values.
